title: Traffic-light town · Level 2: Turn at the sign
brief: The colour robot starts in a 300 x 300 mm start box at the west end of Main Street, a white street 300 mm wide and 1200 mm long (starts vary 10 mm and 2 degrees); the level fixes the robot. Main Street has one traffic light, a 150 x 300 mm patch across the street with its middle 600 mm from the street's start. At the junction at Main Street's east end a yellow 100 x 100 mm turn sign means turn right, onto Side Street, a white street 300 mm wide running 1200 mm south with one traffic light across it, its middle 600 mm from the junction. The lights are painted red or green, changing every 4 s, each starting at a moment new every run. The school, a blue 300 x 300 mm zone, is at Side Street's south end. A run ends once the program has ended and the robot has then stood still for 0.5 s, or at 60 s. A robot whose colour sensor leaves a light on the far side while it is red has run a red light: that run scores 0. A run finishes when the robot stops with its middle in the school without running a red light. Per run: 50 for finishing, plus up to 40 for speed on the driving time (the run's time less the time the robot stood still; all 40 at 22 s or less, 40 x 22 / driving time above it), both paid only on a finish; plus 10 if at every stop on a red light the colour sensor was short of the light's middle line. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them finished. Par time: 22 s.

score.run: round(if(redRun, 0, if(stopped & inSchool, 50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(driveS, 0.001)), 0) + if(redStopPast == 0, 10, 0)), 1)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)
